name: Omarchy Display Workspaces
author: nephilus (based on Omarchy)
description: Per-display workspaces, guarded session layouts, safe undock/redock, and optional automatic profiles

barWidget.description: The green display highlight follows the cursor. Right-click for compact Displays, Workspaces, and Profiles tabs. Arrange advertised modes, scale, placement, and workspace assignments through a guarded 20-second Preview. Confirmed Undock safely immediately leaves the internal panel enabled, moves external workspaces, and disables external outputs; confirmed Redock safely re-enables every display disabled by this session. Manual new-connector changes use native output management without writing monitor rules. Apply is session-only. Profiles capture confirmed live arrangements; optional automatic restoration requires explicit consent and supported exact rules. Names, icons and order save separately. Forget performs confirmed configuration cleanup with exact backups.
